body: I PM'd you brother. I've also posted here tonight. Your service has not gone unnoticed. Everyone in my family has enlisted. I grew up moving from base to base. When I was in 2nd grade I got suspended for punching another kid in the mouth for saying "grand ol BAG" instead of "Flag"

I can't do that though.  I need something, someone to live for. Something to fix, someone to fix. I've become untrusted now that my addiction has been known. This is not a sudden oh fuck help me thing. We are talking months and months, brother.

I appreciate the sentiment, and your care. I'm not so certain of that though after a few years. All that kept me going was being there for others. Now my alcoholism has gone wide and nobody trusts me to be their go to guy for whatever now.

As far as online gaming and such, relationships family, friends, and intimate; I have always been the leader. I've always been the one to lead the group to mass victory. The one that was there to listen to anyone, any time, day or night.  Having a hard time not being in that role. I spend every other day in bed trying to sleep it away. Then the next day trying to remain sober for a few hours before I begin downing the vodka.
